title: Sell what you grow
intro: If you grow food, your account can become a stall at one of the four markets. You keep everything you have now and carry on shopping from other stalls.

next.title: What happens after you send this
next.read: An admin reads the application and looks at your photos, usually within a few market days.
next.panel: When it is approved, a stall panel appears in your account for stock, orders and pickup times.
next.setup: You set your markets, days and pickup windows there, then list your first products.

step1.title: Your stall
step1.stallNameHint: Customers see this on the map and on their orders.
step1.aboutPlaceholder: One or two sentences. Who grows it and where.
step1.fromAccount: From your account. Change it on the Account page first if it's wrong.

step2.title: What you grow
step2.cropsPlaceholder: Water spinach, choy sum, Thai basil
step2.cropsHint: Separate them with commas. You list real products with prices after approval.
step2.volumeHint: A rough figure. It helps the admin match you to a market with room.
step2.methodPlaceholder: e.g. No pesticides in the last two seasons.
step2.methodHint: Optional, and shown on your stall page as your own words. MarketLink does not check or certify any of it.

step3.title: Where you grow it
step3.plotHint: Only the admin sees this. Customers see your stall at the market, not your plot.
step3.map: Pin your plot on the map
step3.pinHint: Drag the pin to your plot. It is the quickest way for the admin to see the photos match the place.

step4.title: Photos of the plot
step4.intro: Two photos are enough and five is the most. One wide shot that shows the whole plot, and one close shot of what is growing right now. Take them in the last 30 days and do not filter them.
step4.addVideo: Add a video, up to 60 seconds
step4.videoHint: Optional. A slow walk along the beds says more than any photo, and it makes approval faster.

banner.title: The admin is checking one thing: that the plot exists and grows what you listed.
banner.text: MarketLink does not check licences, food safety or organic claims, and a photo is not a certificate.

step5.title: Where you want to sell
step5.hint: Pick one to start with. You set your days, pickup windows and cutoff in the stall panel once you are approved, and you can add the other markets later.

step6.title: Before you send
step6.true: Everything here is true, and the photos are of my own plot
step6.trueHint: An application with photos that are not yours is rejected and the account can be suspended.
step6.present: I will be at the stall in my pickup window
step6.presentHint: Repeated no-shows are the usual reason a stall is suspended.
step6.pay: I understand customers pay me at the stall
step6.payHint: There is no online payment and no delivery anywhere in MarketLink.

sent.title: Your application is with an admin
sent.intro: Nothing changes for you in the meantime. Keep shopping, and watch your notifications for the answer.

accepted.title: An admin reads it
accepted.note: Usually within a few market days

toast.missing: Tick the three boxes at the end before you send.
toast.sent: You will hear from an admin in your notifications.

loadError.title: Couldn't load your application status
loadError.text: Check your connection and try again.

errors.photo: Could not upload that photo. Please try again.
errors.video: Could not upload that video. Please try again.
errors.send: Could not send your application. Please try again.

approved.title: Your stall is approved
approved.text: Your account can now set up a stall — markets, pickup windows and products — from the farmer panel.

rejected.title: Your application was not approved
rejected.text: Contact an admin from the feedback form if you think this is a mistake.

suspended.title: Your stall is suspended
suspended.text: You can still sign in, but your products stay hidden from customers until an admin lifts the suspension.

suspendedBanner.title: Selling is paused on this account.
suspendedBanner.text: Existing orders already placed still run their course; you just cannot take new ones for now.
